name: DataTable
label: Data table
description: The wired table: typed columns, sorting, filters, editing, grouping with totals, row details, saved views, thousands of rows, and rows from a server.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row data, as raw values the table can sort and search.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page, for controlled use (or as a fixed setting). Setting this or `defaultPageSize` turns on the built-in pagination.

props.name: defaultPageSize
props.description: Rows per page to start with, for uncontrolled use; `pageSizeOptions` then lets the reader change it.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: Fires with the new page size when the reader picks one from `pageSizeOptions`.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: The page sizes the footer offers in a Rows per page picker. Leave unset for no picker.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, counting from 1, for controlled use. Pair with `onPageChange`. A page past the last shows the last.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: The page to start on, counting from 1, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Fires with the new page, counting from 1: from the pager, and back to 1 when a search, filter, sort or page size change starts over.

props.name: pageSizeLabel
props.description: The page size picker's label. Defaults to "Rows per page".

props.name: phoneLayout
props.description:
How the table reads when it is narrower than a phone (its own width,
under `BREAKPOINT_PHONE_PX`, so a table in a narrow panel counts):
`scroll` keeps the rows and scrolls sideways with the row header
pinned; `stack` draws each row as a card, its row header as the title
and every other column as a label and value pair. Defaults to `scroll`.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Adds a checkbox column with a select-all header.

props.name: selectedIds
props.description: Selected row ids for controlled use. Pair with `onSelectionChange`.

props.name: defaultSelectedIds
props.description: Initially selected row ids for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Fires with the full list of selected row ids after every change.

props.name: sort
props.description: Sort state for controlled use. Pair with `onSortChange`; `null` means unsorted.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort state for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Fires with the new sort state — `null` when a third click clears the sort.

props.name: sorts
props.description: Every sort, first sort first, for controlled use: the several-column form of `sort`, and wins over it when both are given. Pair with `onSortsChange`.

props.name: defaultSorts
props.description: Initial sorts for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onSortsChange
props.description: Fires with every sort after one changes, first sort first. `onSortChange` fires too, with the first or `null`.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description: The link component a `link` column's cells render through, so the app's router handles them. Defaults to the nearest `LinkProvider`'s, else a plain anchor.

props.name: virtualize
props.description:
Draws only the rows in view, so a table of thousands scrolls as
smoothly as one of ten. `auto` (the default) does it for an unpaged,
ungrouped table of more than 200 rows; `true` always; `false` never.
A virtualised table scrolls inside its frame (`maxHeight`, 640px when
unset), keeps its header in view, and still sends its first screen of
rows in the server's HTML.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the reader scrolls near the end of the rows while `hasMore` is set, to fetch the next batch. Called once per batch: append the rows and it can fire again.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether more rows can be fetched: shows a loading row at the end and calls `onLoadMore` as it comes into view.

props.name: manual
props.description:
Hands sorting, filtering, search and paging to the host, for a table
whose rows live on a server. The table stops doing them itself and
reports every change through its pairs (`onSortsChange`,
`onFiltersChange`, `onSearchChange`, `onPageChange`,
`onPageSizeChange`); pass back `rows` already sorted, filtered and
paged. Totals, grouping and Select all work over the rows given, and
Select all N from a TableToolbar selects every match as a query.

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Every row that matches on the server, in `manual` mode: drives the pager, the result count and Select all N. Defaults to the rows given.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether rows are being fetched. With no rows yet the body shows skeleton rows; with rows on screen they stay, dimmed and inert, under a thin progress line, so the table never blanks.

props.name: error
props.description: A failed load's message. With no rows it replaces the body with an error state; over rows already on screen it shows as a Banner above them. Pair with `onRetry`.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called by the error state's Try again button. Without it the error shows with no button.

props.name: loadLabels
props.description: The words of loading and failed loads, merged over their English defaults: the skeleton rows' name, the loading row, a failed load's title and its retry button.

props.name: renderDetail
props.description: Renders a row's details: adds a chevron column, and an opened row shows this beneath it, across the table's width. Rendered only once opened.

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: The ids of the rows whose details are open, for controlled use. Pair with `onExpandedIdsChange`.

props.name: defaultExpandedIds
props.description: The rows open to begin with, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onExpandedIdsChange
props.description: Fires with the open rows' ids after one opens or closes.

props.name: expandMode
props.description: Whether several rows' details can be open at once (`multiple`, the default) or opening one closes the rest (`single`).

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Fires with the table's setup as a view whenever any part of it changes, so a host can keep the reader's last view.

props.name: grouping
props.description: The column keys the rows are grouped by, for controlled use; this milestone draws the first. Pair with `onGroupingChange`.

props.name: defaultGrouping
props.description: The grouping to start with, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onGroupingChange
props.description: Fires with the new grouping, from a header menu or a TableToolbar.

props.name: totalsRow
props.description: Adds a totals row to the table's foot, sticky at its bottom edge: each cell a menu picking its calculation over every matching row.

props.name: totals
props.description: Each column's footer calculation, by key, for controlled use. A column left out shows its `aggregate`, or nothing. Pair with `onTotalsChange`.

props.name: defaultTotals
props.description: The footer calculations to start with, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onTotalsChange
props.description: Fires with every footer calculation after one is picked.

props.name: multiSort
props.description: Lets the table sort by several columns: Shift-click a header, or pick Add to sort from its menu, to add the column after the current sorts. Each sorted header shows its rank while more than one sorts.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Shows the built-in search field, matching against every column's raw value.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the search field.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Slot beside the search field for consumer-owned filter controls.

props.name: size
props.description:
The table's density, and the controls' with it: `default` rows with the
search field and pager at the default row-control height, `compact` rows
with both at the compact one. Controls inside the rows (checkboxes, grips,
menu and action buttons) stay compact at either density, so a row's
height is its text's. Defaults to `default`. Unlike a static size, it is
state the reader can change from a TableToolbar's density switch: passing
it controls that state, paired with `defaultSize` and `onSizeChange`.

props.name: striped
props.description: Alternating row backgrounds, passed through to the underlying Table.

props.name: caption
props.description: Accessible caption for the underlying table (visually hidden).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: What to render when no rows match — defaults to a built-in empty state.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the select-all checkbox in the header, shown with `selectable`.
props.default: Select all rows on this page

props.name: selectRowLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of a row's checkbox, given the row. Defaults to "Select"
followed by the value of the `rowHeader` column (else the first column),
and to "Select row" with the id only when that value is empty.

props.name: sortLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of a sortable header's button, given the column's header
text (its `key` when the header is not a string) and its current sort
direction, `null` when unsorted. Defaults to the header text alone: the
sort state is the header's `aria-sort`, so naming it here too would read
it twice.

props.name: sortAnnouncement
props.description: Announced when the sort changes, given the header text and the new direction, `null` when cleared. Defaults to "Sorted by Name, ascending" or "Sort cleared".
props.defaultExpression:
(header: string, direction: DataTableSort['direction'] | null) =>
    direction === null ? 'Sort cleared' : `Sorted by ${header}, ${direction === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : 'descending'}`

props.name: sortRankLabel
props.description: With several sorts, names a header's sort button after the first: given the `sortLabel` name, its rank and its direction. Defaults to "Owner, sort 2, ascending". The first sort's header carries `aria-sort` instead.
props.defaultExpression:
(name: string, rank: number, direction: DataTableSort['direction']) =>
    `${name}, sort ${rank}, ${direction === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : 'descending'}`

props.name: pageAnnouncement
props.type: ((page: number, pageCount: number, first: number, last: number, total: number) => string)
props.description: Announced when the page changes, given the page, the page count, the first and last row shown and the total. Defaults to "Page 2 of 7, rows 21 to 40 of 140".
props.defaultExpression:
(page: number, pageCount: number, first: number, last: number, total: number) =>
    `Page ${page} of ${pageCount}, rows ${first} to ${last} of ${total}`

props.name: resultsLabel
props.description: Footer count of the rows that match, given the count. Defaults to "1 result" or "N results".

props.name: selectedLabel
props.description: Footer count shown instead of the results while rows are selected, given the count. Defaults to "N selected".

props.name: paginationLabels
props.description:
The built-in pager's words, merged over its English defaults: the arrows'
names ("Previous page", "Next page"), the readout ("Page 2 of 4") and the
landmark's name ("Pagination"). The pager follows the table's `size`:
numbered pages at the default size (named by `pageLabel`), a "Page X of Y"
readout when compact (`readoutLabel`).

props.name: emptyStateLabels
props.description:
The built-in empty state's words, merged over its English defaults
("No matching rows", "Adjust the search or filters and try again.").
Ignored when `emptyState` replaces the whole node.

props.name: resizableColumns
props.description: Lets every column be resized by dragging its header's edge, double-clicking it to fit, or Alt+Left and Alt+Right on a focused header. A column's own `resizable` wins.

props.name: reorderableColumns
props.description: Lets every column be moved by dragging its header, from its menu, or Ctrl+Shift+Left and Ctrl+Shift+Right on a focused header. A column's own `reorderable` wins.

props.name: columnMenu
props.description: Adds a menu to every header: sort, pin, move, hide, fit and reset, as each column allows. Opened from the header's options button, Alt+Down, Shift+F10 or a right-click.

props.name: reorderableRows
props.description: Adds a grip at each row's start to drag it up or down, or move it with Alt+Up and Alt+Down. Off while a sort is active, since the sort owns the order.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keeps the header in view while the body scrolls. Takes effect with `maxHeight`, inside the table's own scroll frame.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The table's tallest height before its body scrolls inside its frame (any CSS length, or pixels).

props.name: navigation
props.description:
How the keyboard moves through the table. `table` keeps every control in
the Tab order, as a reading table does; `grid` makes the table one Tab
stop with arrow-key focus across its cells. Defaults to `grid` when any
column or row control is on, else `table`.

props.name: columnWidths
props.description: Column widths in pixels, by key, for controlled use. Fires `onColumnWidthsChange` once per resize, on release.

props.name: defaultColumnWidths
props.description: Starting column widths in pixels, by key, for uncontrolled use. Columns not listed take their natural width.

props.name: onColumnWidthsChange
props.description: Fires with every column's width after a resize, a fit or a reset.

props.name: columnOrder
props.description: Column keys in display order, for controlled use. Keys left out keep their declared order after the listed ones.

props.name: defaultColumnOrder
props.description: Starting column order, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onColumnOrderChange
props.description: Fires with the full column order after a move.

props.name: columnPinning
props.description: Columns pinned to each edge, for controlled use.

props.name: defaultColumnPinning
props.description: Starting pins, for uncontrolled use; merged with each column's own `pin`.

props.name: onColumnPinningChange
props.description: Fires with the pins after a column is pinned or unpinned.

props.name: hiddenColumns
props.description: Hidden column keys, for controlled use.

props.name: defaultHiddenColumns
props.description: Starting hidden keys, for uncontrolled use; merged with each column's `defaultHidden`.

props.name: onHiddenColumnsChange
props.description: Fires with every hidden key after a column is hidden or shown.

props.name: rowOrder
props.description: Row ids in display order, for controlled use, applied while no sort is active. Rows left out keep their given order after the listed ones.

props.name: defaultRowOrder
props.description: Starting row order, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onRowOrderChange
props.description: Fires with the full row order after a row moves.

props.name: columnLabels
props.description: The column and row controls' words, merged over their English defaults.

props.name: columnDividers
props.description: Draws a vertical line between columns, as well as the lines between rows.

props.name: cellText
props.description: How every cell's text fits unless its column says otherwise: `wrap` (the default), `nowrap`, `truncate` or `lines-2`.

props.name: rowActions
props.description: The actions a row offers, in an actions column that sticks to the end edge: inline ones as icon buttons, the rest in a More menu.

props.name: editMode
props.description:
How editable cells edit: `cell` (the default) edits one cell at a time,
started with Enter, F2, a typed character or a double click; `row` adds an
Edit button to each row that opens every editable cell of the row at
once, with Save and Cancel.

props.name: onCellEdit
props.description:
Saves one edited cell. Rows stay the record: update them from here. Return
a promise to have the cell show the new value as pending until it
settles; a rejection rolls the cell back and announces the failure.

props.name: onRowEdit
props.description: Saves one edited row with `editMode="row"`, its changed values together. Without it, each changed cell goes to `onCellEdit`.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filters, for controlled use: conditions on columns, joined with AND. Set from the header menus (with `columnMenu`) or a TableToolbar.

props.name: defaultFilters
props.description: Starting filters, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Fires with every filter after one is added, changed or removed.

props.name: search
props.description: The search text, for controlled use; the built-in search field and a TableToolbar's both set it.

props.name: defaultSearch
props.description: Starting search text, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Fires with the search text as it changes.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Starting density, for uncontrolled use when a TableToolbar's density switch sets it; `size` controls it.

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Fires when a TableToolbar's density switch changes the density.

props.name: filterLabels
props.description: The filters' words, merged over their English defaults.

props.name: rowActionsVisibility
props.description: When the inline actions show: on row hover and focus (the default, and always on a touch screen), or always. The More button shows at rest either way, so the column never reads as empty.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The BCP 47 locale the table formats and sorts in, such as `de-DE`: every
typed column without a `format.locale` of its own, and the order text
sorts in. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

Aggregate.description: The calculations a column's `aggregate` can name.

CellEditorKind.description: The editor kinds a column can name, each one of the library's fields.

CellValue.definition: type CellValue = string | number | boolean | string[] | null | undefined;
CellValue.description: Any value a cell can hold.

ColumnFormat.description: How a typed column formats its values.

ColumnType.description: The types a column can be.

DataTableAggregate.description: The calculations a column's `aggregate` can name.

DataTableCellEdit.description: One saved cell, as `onCellEdit` hears it.

DataTableCellText.description:
How a cell's text fits its width: `wrap` breaks onto as many lines as it
needs; `nowrap` stays on one line and runs on; `truncate` stays on one
line and ends in an ellipsis, with the full text as the cell's tooltip;
`lines-2` wraps onto two lines at most, then ends in an ellipsis.

DataTableColumnFormat.description: How a typed column formats its values.

DataTableColumnPinning.description: Columns pinned to either edge, by column key, in order from that edge.

DataTableColumnType.description: The types a column can be; see `DataTableColumn.type`.

DataTableEditorContext.description: What a custom editor is handed.

DataTableEditorKind.description: The editor kinds a column's `editor` can name, each composed from the library's own field.

DataTableFilter.description: One filter condition on one column, as the table and TableToolbar share it.

DataTableFilterLabels.description: Every word a filter shows or announces, each defaulting to English.

DataTableLoadLabels.description: Every word the table shows while rows load or fail to, each defaulting to English.

DataTableOption.description: One choice of a `select`, `multiselect` or `combobox` editor.

DataTableRowAction.description: One action a row offers in its actions column.

DataTableRowEdit.description: One saved row, as `onRowEdit` hears it.

DataTableTotal.description: Every calculation the totals footer offers, `none` included.

DataTableValue.description: Any value a cell can hold.

DataTableView.description: One saved setup of a table: its sorts, filters, search, columns, pinning, widths, grouping, density and page size. Selection, the page and open details are the session, never part of a view.

EmptyStateOwnProps.description: Props owned by EmptyState itself — everything else falls through to the root div.

FilterLabels.description: Every word a filter shows or announces, each defaulting to English.

FilterValue.definition: type FilterValue = string | number | [number | string | null, number | string | null] | string[] | null | undefined;
FilterValue.description: A filter's value: text or a date for one-value operators, a number, a pair for `between`, a list for the set operators.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

PaginationOwnProps.description: Props owned by Pagination itself — everything else falls through to the nav landmark.

StatusRole.description: A status option's role, the Badge variant its cells take.

TableView.description: One saved setup of a table. Every field is optional: a view leaves out what it does not set.

Total.description: Every calculation the totals footer offers, `none` included (Notion's Calculate set).
